room_tone.properties: Signal chain: Learn: Input → 2048-Point FFT (4× overlap, Hann) → Power per Bin and Cross Spectrum. Fill: Learnt Magnitudes + Random Phases (Park-Miller) → IFFT Overlap-Add → Fill Level. Gap Detector (10 ms Power, Threshold, Hold) → Top-Up to the Room Tone → Fade → Output = Input + Fill. The fill never repeats, keeps the stereo coherence of the recording and adds only what is missing, so a gap that still holds its room tone gets nothing; no latency. The profile lives in memory and is not saved with the project: learn again after a reload.

binaural_panner.properties: Signal chain: Input (Mono Sum or two Stereo Sources) → Air Absorption Low-Pass → Rear Pinna Shelf (4 kHz) → Elevation Pinna Notch (6–10 kHz) → 1/r Level → per Ear: Woodworth Interaural Delay (fractional, 20 ms glide) → Brown–Duda Head Shadow → + Six Early Reflections (Room) → Output. A spherical-head model, no measured HRTF data: listen with headphones; front and back are less certain than with a measured HRTF. No latency.

string_ensemble.properties: Signal chain: MIDI → a Voice per Key (16', 8' and 4' PolyBLEP Sawtooths, locked an octave apart, free-running) × Attack/Release Envelope → Sum → 12 dB/oct Low-Pass (Brightness) → Body Resonances (450 Hz, 2.8 kHz) → Three-Tap Ensemble (slow and fast LFOs, 120° apart; mod wheel deepens it) → Volume. Fully polyphonic like the divide-down originals, no samples; sustain pedal, pitch bend ±2 semitones, all MIDI passed on.
